regressions.cause: Pointer motion outside an open note editor returned before clearing saved-card hover; actions stayed visible after saving.
regressions.fix: Clear saved-card hover on composer mouse motion before the outside-bounds early return.

regressions.cause: An automatic cancellation status message consumed the row needed to reveal the first changed line at 104x12.
regressions.fix: Cancellation returns focus without introducing a status message, matching useUserNoteComposer.ts:189-192.

regressions.cause: A persistent automatic command-title caption survived the picker and duplicated its title in the review frame.
regressions.fix: Do not manufacture command-start/success status captions. Preserve explicit extension notifications and attributed failure handling, matching useExtensionCommandRunner.ts.

regressions.cause: An automatic file-presentation success caption consumed a row required by the raw diff. A provisional unconditional selected-hunk reveal made package coverage pass but broke the CSS gallery.
regressions.fix: Remove automatic success captions from direct presentation selection while preserving the scroll position. The pinned DiffPane selection effect requires a new reveal request or pinned-header settle; changed bounds alone do not authorize a jump.
regressions.ptyValidation: All three checked-in gallery PTY tests pass after removing the provisional reveal: 3 passed, 0 failed, 16.03s. See css-gallery-presentation-switch.json for frozen source frames.

unitValidation.phase: Final corrected implementation, executed by the fifth cargo xtask verify run

verificationRerun: Second full run failed with 96 passing and 2 failing PTY tests in 41.65s: the queued-command test depended on an invented success caption, and the provisional presentation reveal broke CSS. Queue test now uses a subsequent rendered key as an input-order barrier and passes in 3.47s; original held-connection and eventual-result assertions remain. After removing the provisional reveal, the third full run passed all 98 PTY tests in 40.68s, then stopped at the key-routing setup failures. Fourth run reached the pane-layout failure documented below. Fifth run passes workspace tests (including 98 PTY tests in 38.85s), formatting, and strict Clippy; release build and smoke checks remain in progress.

keyRoutingFollowup.cause: The third full run passed all 98 PTY tests, then failed two key-routing setup assertions: 30 cursor movements did not scroll the corrected automatic split layout at 120x24.
keyRoutingFollowup.sourcePremise: AppHost.key-routing.test.tsx focuses an overflowing review scroll box without requiring an initial nonzero scroll offset. The native test additionally exercises modal isolation from a nonzero offset.
keyRoutingFollowup.fix: Render between cursor movements and stop when the nonzero-scroll precondition is established, bounded by 160 movements. Preserve the modal scroll-invariance assertions.

paneLayoutFollowup.cause: The fourth full run passed 98 PTY and seven key-routing tests, then failed an exact pane height assertion that still reserved the removed automatic command-success footer.
paneLayoutFollowup.fix: Assert 23 content rows beneath the menu in a 24-row terminal, preserving the exact 28-to-38 column resize and menu-toggle checks.

finalVerification.workspaceTests: passed, with one ignored tooling test

scope: Native integration regressions discovered by the broad verifier. No source ledger interval is newly mapped by these fixes, and no release or complete parity claim is made.
